newsitem.title: USA: Wesley Jessen Visioncare Inc Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Wesley Jessen Visioncare Inc Q1 results.

text.p: (dollars in thousands, except per share amounts)
Income (loss) before income taxes and extraordinary items
Extraordinary item, net of income tax

(A) Adjusted to (i) eliminate the $13,092 non-recurring impact of the inventory write-up from the company's application of purchase accounting with the Barnes Hind acquisition October 1996; (ii) exclude $751 in non-recurring transitional administrative expenses incurred at the Barnes Hind corporate California facility; (iii) reflect the $411 pro forma reduction in interest expense from the February 1997 refinancing of a bank credit agreement and the use of a portion of the net proceeds of the February 1997 IPO to repay outstanding debt; (iv) eliminate the $4,902 ($7,428 pre-tax) extraordinary write-off of capitalized financing fees; (v) reflect income tax expense resulting from the preceding adjustments at an effective income tax rate of 34 percent.
(B) Adjusted to give effect to (i) the Barnes Hind

Acquisition; (ii) the March 1997 divestiture of the Barnes Hind U.S. Natural Touch product line; (iii) the elimination of the non-recurring impact of the inventory step-up in the June 1995 Wesley Jessen acquisition; (iv) the refinancing of the then outstanding bank credit agreement; and (v) the company's IPO and the application of the net proceeds, as if each had occurred on January 1, 1996.
